# chemicalresistance.org

## About
ChemicalResistance.org is a free chemical resistance reference. It republishes the chemical resistance list of Bürkle GmbH: ratings for 835 chemicals against 24 materials (plastics, fluoropolymers, elastomers, stainless steel, aluminium) at 20 °C and 50 °C, by concentration.

## How to read the data
- Ratings: A very good resistance, B good, C limited, D not resistant.
- Ratings depend on concentration. Each chemical page lists every concentration in the source.
- Values marked "est." are estimates in the source, not test results.
- For metals, "L" marks a risk of pitting or stress-corrosion cracking.
- Values that were corrected against other published sources, or that other sources dispute, are listed on the page with references.

## Content
- 193 chemical pages, each with the full table for that chemical
- 24 material pages listing every chemical rated for the material
- Comparison charts by material group
- Chemical storage compatibility guide
- SDS (Safety Data Sheet) decoder
- Available in English, German and Spanish
